classification: pre-registered financial quality/value composite admission; train/validation selection, test confirmation; no promotion
comparison_baseline: current 4 dual-admitted factors (cash-flow stability, dividend yield, fund holding ratio low, idio-vol 40d low)
known_limits: This is a composite of existing catalog factors, not a new raw data source.
The current HS300 membership applied to history retains survivorship bias.
Industry classification is a current snapshot, not historical vintage.
Financial PIT is verified at the builder level; announcement-source anomalies are addressed by statutory-date fallback.
No leverage and no portfolio/order promotion.

positive_control.check: value_quality must pass all three horizons in the frozen output; this proves the gates are satisfiable

score_method: daily cross-sectional rank z-score per member, equal weight; require all members non-null; industry+size neutral IC audit after construction
